import 'dart:convert';
import 'dart:io';

import 'package:artificer_core/artificer_core.dart';
import 'package:artificer_core/transport.dart';
import 'package:conflux/effect.dart';
import 'package:conflux/flow.dart';
import 'package:dart_mappable/dart_mappable.dart';

final class TestOptions {
  const TestOptions(this.tag);
  final String tag;
}

final class TextProvider implements LanguageModelProvider {
  TextProvider(this.endpoint);
  final Uri endpoint;
  final client = ProviderHttpClient();
  @override
  TextModel languageModel(String modelId) => TextModel(this, modelId);
  Future<void> close() => client.close();
}

final class TextModel implements LanguageModel {
  TextModel(this.provider, this.modelId) {
    if (modelId.isEmpty) throw ArgumentError.value(modelId, 'modelId');
  }
  final TextProvider provider;
  @override
  final String modelId;
  @override
  String get providerId => 'fixture';
  @override
  ModelCapabilities get capabilities => const ModelCapabilities();
  @override
  Effect<GenerationResult, AiError> generate(GenerationRequest request, {TestOptions? options}) =>
      Effect.defer((_) => provider.client.requestJson(
        url: provider.endpoint,
        body: {
          'model': modelId,
          'messages': [for (final message in request.messages)
            if (message is UserMessage) {'role': 'user', 'content': [for (final part in message.parts) if (part is TextInputPart) part.text].join()}],
          ...request.options.resolve().toWire(),
          if (options != null) 'tag': options.tag,
        },
      ).map((response, _) {
        final data = response.data as Map<String, Object?>;
        return GenerationResult(
          message: AssistantMessage([TextOutputPart(data['reply'] as String)]),
          finishReason: FinishReason.stop,
          native: NativePayload(providerId: providerId, api: 'fixture', modelId: modelId, data: data),
          metadata: response.metadata,
        );
      }));
  @override
  Flow<GenerationEvent, AiError> stream(GenerationRequest request) =>
      generate(request).asFlow().map((result, _) => GenerationFinished(result));
}

Future<void> main() async {
  initializeMappers();
  initializeMappers();
  final server = await HttpServer.bind(InternetAddress.loopbackIPv4, 0);
  final bodies = <Map<String, Object?>>[];
  server.listen((request) async {
    bodies.add(jsonDecode(await utf8.decoder.bind(request).join()) as Map<String, Object?>);
    request.response.headers.contentType = ContentType.json;
    request.response.write(jsonEncode({'reply': 'hello', 'unknown': {'nested': [1, true]}}));
    await request.response.close();
  });
  final provider = TextProvider(Uri.parse('http://127.0.0.1:${server.port}/generate'));
  final runtime = Runtime();
  try {
    final model = provider.languageModel('unfamiliar-model');
    final common = model as LanguageModel;
    final parts = <InputPart>[const TextInputPart('question')];
    final request = GenerationRequest(messages: [UserMessage(parts)]);
    final operation = common.generate(request);
    if (bodies.isNotEmpty) throw StateError('eager inference');
    parts.add(const TextInputPart('!'));
    final results = await runtime.run(Effect.all([operation, operation]));
    if (results case Succeeded(:final value)) {
      for (final result in value) {
        final restored = GenerationResult.fromJson(result.toJson());
        if (restored.text != 'hello' || restored.usage != null) throw StateError('result persistence');
        final viaMap = GenerationResult.fromMap(restored.toMap());
        if ((viaMap.native.data as Map)['unknown'] == null) throw StateError('unknown data lost');
        final polymorphic = MapperContainer.globals.fromMap<Message>(result.message.toMap());
        if (polymorphic is! AssistantMessage) throw StateError('polymorphic decoding');
        if (result.toString().contains('hello') || result.metadata.toString().contains('headers')) throw StateError('diagnostic leak');
      }
    } else {
      throw StateError('$results');
    }
    final override = await runtime.run(model.generate(request, options: const TestOptions('typed')));
    if (override is! Succeeded<GenerationResult, AiError>) throw StateError('typed options');
    if (bodies.length != 3 || bodies.first['model'] != 'unfamiliar-model' || bodies.first['max_tokens'] != 4096 || bodies.first.containsKey('temperature')) throw StateError('wire defaults/attempts');
    if ((bodies.first['messages'] as List).first['content'] != 'question!') throw StateError('cold ordinary collections');
    if (bodies.last['tag'] != 'typed') throw StateError('concrete options');
    final restoredRequest = GenerationRequest.fromJson(request.toJson());
    if (restoredRequest.messages.length != 1) throw StateError('request persistence');
    final unknownVersion = AssistantMessage([]).toMap()..['schemaVersion'] = 2;
    var rejected = false;
    try { AssistantMessage.fromMap(unknownVersion); } on Object { rejected = true; }
    if (!rejected) throw StateError('unknown version accepted');
  } finally {
    await provider.close();
    await runtime.close();
    await server.close(force: true);
  }
}
